precondition: top-level and nested/local PDF line paths share scoped Butt=0, Round=1, Square=2 semantics; tokenized balanced q/Q parsing identifies the sole innermost line-paint scope; default Butt omits 0 J

variants.transform: omit 1 J for Round in one path
emit 1 J instead of 2 J for Square
apply cap mapping only to top-level lines and omit it for local/nested lines
emit J outside the selected innermost balanced line q/Q scope, or after the line m/l/S path begins
emit 0 J for legacy Butt even when the default state suffices

variant_killers.M30d-leak-state: balanced token parsing selects exactly one innermost scope containing w/m/l/S; a synthetic outer-scope 1 J and an unbalanced q stream must fail, while real top-level/local Round and Square require their sole J inside that scope before m, then l, then S

validity: Each variant must be killed in both path/scoping semantics where applicable. M30d requires the public outer-leak and unbalanced negative controls plus the real top-level/local paths; raw substring presence is not credit. Redundant 0 J is killed by deterministic legacy Butt bytes and explicit omission.
